book.title: To Madojow no Nawnangonon no Sinuyat ni Marcos

content: To Madaogon no Pagsed ni Jesus to Jerusalem
No madani on sikandan to Jerusalem, ogkaaha dan on to mgo yunsud to Betpahe dow Betania duon to bugdangan to Kaulibuhan no bubungan. Dajun sugu si Jesus to daduwa no mgo inanad din,
“Andutun kow to suja baryu. Pagtidow now duon, ogkita kow dajun to inhikot no nati no asnu
no wada pad disti kasakaji. Hubada aw tujuka dini kanay.
Ko meyduon ogsagman iyu, ilingi now no ogkinahangyanon seini to Ginuu, di madali da ig-uli.”
Dajun panow sikan daduwa. Pagtidow dan, pigkita dan iyan sikan nati no asnu no inhikot duon to pertahan to bayoy duon to kilid to karsada. Anoy man no oghubadon dan on,
mey mgo otow no migsagman kandan. Kagi pa, “Nokoy no oghubadon now man sikan nati?”
Iyan intabak dan to intugun ni Jesus, kaling pigtugutan dajun sikandan.
Dajun dan tujuka sikan nati diya ki Jesus. Inhanig dan to pig-apid dan no kabo duon to talikudan to nati aw dajun sakoy si Jesus.
Mahan-in to mgo otow no migbukyad isab to ing-apid dan no mgo kabo aw ihanig to ogbajaan din. To duma namanagkas to mgo dodohunan diya to mgo uma aw ihanig dan isab.
Namanguliya sikan tibo mgo otow no migduma ki Jesus duon to unahan dow duon to hudihan, “Sajaon ta to Diyus! Sajaon seini pigpaandini din ita!
Kadojow gajod to ogpaabuton ta no paghari to seini Kaliwat ni Hari David no minuna ta! Sajaon yagboy to Diyus diya to yangit!”

Pagtidow ni Jesus diya to Jerusalem, migpadajun sikandin duon to Bayoy to Diyus aw panhiling-hilinga din to tibo duon. Dajun yuwas sikandin dow sikan sampuyu-tag-duwa no mgo inanad din aw pauli diya to baryu to Betania su mahapun on.
To Pagtubad ni Jesus to Kaju no Wada Bogas
Pagkabukas, miglikat sikandan to Betania su ogpauli diya to Jerusalem. Duon pad sikandan to pangindaenan, pigbontas on si Jesus.
Na, diya to kadiyuan migkita sikandin to kaju no igera no madabu to dohun. Pig-anduon din su og-ahaon dow mey bogas. Di dohun da to pigkita din su kona pad no tigbobogas.
Dajun tubadi ni Jesus sikan igera, “Sugud kuntoon, kona kad on ogpakabogas.” Na, pigdinog to mgo inanad din sikan pig-ikagi din.
To Pag-abug ni Jesus to mgo Mamaligjaay duon to Bayoy to Diyus

Pagtidow dan diya to Jerusalem, mig-isab si Jesus mig-andiya to Bayoy to Diyus aw pang-abuga din to mgo otow no namoli aw namaligja duon. Aw pamaliskada din to mgo lamisa to mgo magsinsilyuhay to saepi dow mgo ingkudanan to diya namaligja to salapati no ighalad.
Wada otow no pigtugutan din to pagpanyaktod duon to pawa to sikan Bayoy to Diyus no ogdae to inggad nokoy da.

Dajun din pang-anada to mgo otow duon. Kagi din, “Meyduon impasuyat to Diyus no pig-iling, ‘To bayoy ku og-ilingon to ampuanan to mgo sakup to yain-yain no mgo nasyun.’ Di pighinang now no kampu to mgo tulisan!”

Sikan no hitabu pigdinog to yabow no mgo magdudumaya to tinuuhan to mgo Hibru dow to mgo maistru to tinuuhan. Kaling mighona-hona sikandan dow og-amonuhon dan agun mahimatajan si Jesus su nahaedok sikandan kandin, su to tibo mgo otow naliyag to pagpang-anad din.
Anoy man no madidigyomay on, migyuwas si Jesus to siyudad dow mgo inanad din.
Namatoy to diya Igera
Pagkabukas, no ogpauli on si Jesus dow mgo inanad din diya to siyudad, pigkita dan no patoy on sikan igera no pigtubadan ni Jesus yakip to mgo dalid.
Na, pagkadomdom ni Pedro to diya tubad ni Jesus to sikan igera, mig-ikagi sikandin, “Sir, aha ka. Patoy on suja igera no pigtubadan nu gabii!”
Kagi ni Jesus, “Saligi to Diyus
aw ligdongi now seini. Ko mey otow no ogsugu to suja bubungan, ‘Kayukat ka duon aw patiagdang ka dutun to dagat,’ ogkatuman sikan basta wada pagduwa-duwa to pagtuu din.
Angod isab to sikan, inggad nokoy to ogbujuon now to Diyus, tuuhi no imbogoy din on iyu. Su ko mutuu kow, ogkadawat now yagboy to ogbujuon now.
Na, ko og-ampu kow di mey otow no ogpakadoot to ginhawa now, unaha sikandin pasayluha ayha kow ampu. Na, ogpasayluhon kow isab to Diyus no Amoy now diya to yangit.”
To Katongod ni Jesus

Na, migtidow on isab onsi Jesus diya to Jerusalem. No mighihipanow si Jesus duon to Bayoy to Diyus, migduguk to yabow no mgo magdudumaya to tinuuhan dan, mgo maistru to tinuuhan dow duma no inila no mgo Hibru.
Kagi dan, “Nokoy man to katongod nu to pagpanghinang to diya? Hintawa man to migbogoy ikow to sikan no katongod?”
Migtabak si Jesus, “Meyduon isab ig-usip ku iyu. Ko tabakon a now, ognangonan ku sikiyu dow nokoy to katongod ku to pagpanghinang to diya.
Na, to diya pagpamawtismu ni Juan, hintawa man to migbogoy kandin to sikan no katongod? Diyus ko otow? Nangoni a.”
Dajun sikandan sasabut dow og-amonuhon dan to pagtabak. Kagi dan, “Ko muiling ki no Diyus to migbogoy ki Juan to katongod, ogsukatan ki din dow nokoy no wada ki tuu ki Juan.
Aw ko muiling ki no pig-otawan to katongod din, adoy!” Nahaedok sikandan to kaotawan su tibo man migtuu no si Juan kibali ba-ba to Diyus.
Kaling iyan da intabak dan ki Jesus to, “Indoy, wada koy kamaan.” “Na,” kagi ni Jesus, “kona ku isab sikiyu ognangonan dow andei kapuun to katongod ku to pagpanghinang to diya.”

footnotes.text: Bersikulu 26 ogkakitaan duon to duma no mgo sinuyat no Ginirigu. Pig-iling: Di ko kona now sikandin pasayluhon, kona kow isab ogpasayluhon to Diyus no Amoy now diya to yangit.
